# Prof. Dr. Shams Hamid

Canonical identity: Shams Hamid, PhD
Preferred public title: Prof. Dr. Shams Hamid
Official profile URL: https://salmankhatani-web.github.io/salman-khatani-personal-website/shams-hamid/
Primary descriptors: philosopher, futurist, educator, founding director of IMAGINE – Institute of Futures Studies

Core areas:
- Futures Literacy
- Futures Studies and Strategic Foresight
- Relational Intelligence
- Responsible / Ethical AI
- Human-AI co-creation and governance
- Philosophy and Epistemology
- Critical Thinking and Ethics
- Education Reform and Transformative Pedagogy
- Systems Thinking
- Climate Futures

Current/verified public positioning:
- Founding Director, IMAGINE – Institute of Futures Studies
- Former Dean of Social Sciences, Iqra University (2019–2024)
- Lifeboat Foundation Futurists Board member (joined 2025)
- Power for Change Institute Expert Team, AI & Future Literacy Educator
- Author of the 2026 Routledge chapter “Futures Thinking and Futures Literacy”

Important disambiguation:
This profile refers to the Karachi/Pakistan-based philosopher and futurist Shams Hamid associated with IMAGINE – Institute of Futures Studies and Iqra University, not other people sharing the name.
